_comment: Fabric A/B: baseline (fabric-jvm-35, plain dbt-fabricspark) vs openivm
(fabric-openivm-jvm-35). Each flavor has its OWN Fabric lakehouse +
environment (shared workspace) so the two run SHARED-NOTHING in PARALLEL.
Runs SF=3 end-to-end TWICE for repeatability / noise characterisation.
Both engines run against remote Fabric Spark via Livy; source data is
staged into each lakehouse's Files/ cache, and data state is blown away
between experiments (see the fabric engine_runner cleanup).
Spark A/B event-log metrics (issue #36) do NOT apply to managed Fabric
Spark, so spark_metrics_capture is off; per-model dbt timings + PASS/FAIL
drive the standard OAT charts / RESULTS.md.
UAMI_SUBSCRIPTION (relay secrets) + the per-flavor FABRIC_*_JVM_35_* IDs.
